description_en: Detaches the AccessKey of a multicloud account, such as a Tencent Cloud or Huawei Cloud account, from a threat analysis data source. You can then attach a new account
description_zh: 解除已经绑定到威胁分析数据源模块的多云（腾讯云、华为云）子账号AK，解绑后可以更换账号重新绑定
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem delete-bind-account --account-id 123xxxxxxx --access-id ABCXXXXXXXX --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBindAccount

parameters.help_en: The binding ID. Call the ListBindAccount (https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CListBindAccount) operation to obtain the binding ID
parameters.name: bind_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud account
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID of the cloud account
parameters.name: access_id

parameters.help_en:
The code for the cloud service provider. Valid values:

qcloud: Tencent Cloud

aliyun: Alibaba Cloud

hcloud: Huawei Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
多云的code。取值：
qcloud：腾讯云。
aliyun：阿里云。
hcloud：华为云
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data center is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in mainland China or the China (Hong Kong) region.

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the view. Valid values:

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts that are managed by your enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can specify this parameter to perform the operation from the perspective of a member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

Count.description_en: The number of account bindings that are deleted. A value of 1 indicates that the operation was successful. A value of 0 or less indicates that the operation failed
Count.description_zh: 删除账号绑定的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败
